product.outcome: Claim completed quest rewards, prepare a loadout, and coordinate the next raid with the clan.

users.who: A Hollowmere player using a second-screen phone between game sessions.

capabilities.note: Read acknowledged character, quest, gear and roster snapshots from Hollowmere.
Claim each completed quest once; uncertain claims are reconciled before another submission.
Persist a gear swap after the game acknowledges the new loadout.
A confirmed sale returns gold and removes that gear; no buyback is promised.
Persist clan planning messages with delivery acknowledgement.
Persist player display and notification preferences.
Notify opted-in players before an active quest deadline.
The companion helps plan a raid but cannot start a match or teleport a character; it has no launch control.

homeReady.label: Session overview
homeReady.rule: Show Kestrel’s acknowledged loadout and the claimable forge reward ahead of unfinished quests.

homeLoading.label: Syncing character
homeLoading.rule: Keep navigation while withholding character totals and claims until the snapshot arrives.

homeEmpty.label: No active quests
homeEmpty.rule: Keep the linked character visible and explain when new daily quests arrive.

homeFailed.label: Game unavailable
homeFailed.rule: Keep the last known character and mark it stale; reconnect before making reward or gear changes.

homeLongContent.label: Long character and quest names
homeLongContent.rule: Wrap the complete character, clan and quest names while keeping numeric power separate.

homePlanned.label: Loadout prepared
homePlanned.rule: Show the acknowledged tempered blade and updated power before the player returns to the game.

questsReady.label: Quest board
questsReady.rule: Distinguish the forge reward ready to claim from active, story and expiring quests.

questsLoading.label: Syncing quests
questsLoading.rule: Hide claim controls until completion and reward identity are confirmed by the game.

questsEmpty.label: No active quests
questsEmpty.rule: Explain the daily reset and return to the character overview.

questsFailed.label: Quest sync failed
questsFailed.rule: Reconnect to fetch current completion before offering any claim.

questsLongContent.label: Long quest narrative
questsLongContent.rule: Wrap the complete story objective; keep chapter, reward amounts and deadline as separate facts.

questsClaiming.label: Claim pending
questsClaiming.rule: Disable another claim while the forge reward is awaiting acknowledgement.

questsClaimed.label: Reward claimed
questsClaimed.rule: Mark the forge quest claimed and link to inventory only after acknowledgement.

questsClaimFailed.label: Claim rejected
questsClaimFailed.rule: Keep the forge reward ready; explain that no reward was delivered and allow a safe retry.

questsClaimUnknown.label: Claim outcome unknown
questsClaimUnknown.rule: Do not resubmit; refresh the claim result to learn whether the reward was delivered.

questsExpired.label: Quest expired
questsExpired.rule: Show the expired arena quest and remove claim controls; no completed reward is implied.

inventoryReady.label: Gear collection
inventoryReady.rule: Compare stored gear with Kestrel’s equipped sword; separate category and each numerical bonus.

inventoryLoading.label: Syncing gear
inventoryLoading.rule: Keep the inventory heading while withholding gear changes until the snapshot arrives.

inventoryEmpty.label: No gear
inventoryEmpty.rule: Keep the character context and route to quest rewards.

inventoryFailed.label: Gear sync failed
inventoryFailed.rule: Keep last known gear visible but disable equip and sell until a fresh snapshot is loaded.

inventoryLongContent.label: Long gear lore
inventoryLongContent.rule: Wrap gear name and lore without losing category, rarity or bonuses.

inventoryEquipping.label: Equipping gear
inventoryEquipping.rule: Keep the selected tempered blade and prevent a duplicate swap until acknowledged.

inventoryEquipped.label: Loadout saved
inventoryEquipped.rule: Show the tempered blade as equipped and Kestrel’s acknowledged new power.

inventoryEquipFailed.label: Swap not saved
inventoryEquipFailed.rule: Keep the prior sword equipped and offer another attempt for the selected tempered blade.

inventorySelling.label: Selling sword
inventorySelling.rule: Keep the selected sword visible but prevent another sale while awaiting acknowledgement.

inventorySold.label: Sale saved
inventorySold.rule: Remove the sold sword and show only the acknowledged gold balance.

inventorySellFailed.label: Sale not saved
inventorySellFailed.rule: Keep the sword in inventory and the prior gold balance; retry the same sale.

clanReady.label: Raid planning
clanReady.rule: Keep the healer request and clan roster next to the message input; this does not start the raid.

clanLoading.label: Loading clan
clanLoading.rule: Retain the clan heading and reserve history without implying a draft was delivered.

clanEmpty.label: No planning messages
clanEmpty.rule: Show the roster and invite the player to post availability for the next raid.

clanFailed.label: Clan unavailable
clanFailed.rule: Keep the history and any draft; reconnect before sending.

clanLongContent.label: Long raid plan
clanLongContent.rule: Wrap the full raid plan and author identity while preserving message order.

clanSending.label: Sending availability
clanSending.rule: Keep the proposed raid message with a pending marker and prevent duplicate delivery.

clanSent.label: Availability sent
clanSent.rule: Show the message as delivered after acknowledgement; the roster can now read it.

clanSendFailed.label: Message not sent
clanSendFailed.rule: Retain the exact draft beside a retry; never show it as delivered.

rankingsReady.label: Weekly rankings
rankingsReady.rule: Sort the acknowledged roster by rank and keep presence separate from combat power.

rankingsLoading.label: Loading ranks
rankingsLoading.rule: Do not invent player positions while fetching the weekly ranking.

rankingsEmpty.label: No weekly ranking
rankingsEmpty.rule: Explain that ranks require a completed quest this week and link to Quests.

rankingsFailed.label: Ranks unavailable
rankingsFailed.rule: Retry the ranking fetch without changing power or completed quests.

rankingsLongContent.label: Long player identities
rankingsLongContent.rule: Wrap the full name and class while keeping rank and power aligned.

settingsReady.label: Player preferences
settingsReady.rule: Player display, server and quest reminder choices are explicitly saved together.

settingsSaving.label: Saving player preferences
settingsSaving.rule: Keep changed values visible while preventing duplicate preference saves.

settingsSaved.label: Player preferences saved
settingsSaved.rule: Confirm display and reminders without changing equipped gear or game progress.

settingsFailed.label: Preferences not saved
settingsFailed.rule: Retain player preference edits and offer a local retry.

helpReady.label: Power and weekly rewards
helpReady.rule: Explain power and ranking reset separately from actions; the companion cannot launch a match.

landingReady.label: About the companion
landingReady.rule: Explain claim, loadout and clan planning against an already linked Hollowmere character; do not promise a linking form.

pushQuestExpiringReady.label: Quest deadline reminder
pushQuestExpiringReady.rule: Notify opted-in players only for the active arena quest and link to its remaining deadline.

inventoryRewardReady.label: Forge reward received
inventoryRewardReady.rule: The newly claimed tempered blade is stored next to the existing loadout; the player can compare it before equipping.

flows.goal: Collect the completed forge quest reward exactly once.
flows.ends: The forge quest is acknowledged as claimed and its tempered blade appears in inventory.

flows.goal: Choose a stronger loadout and tell the clan when I can join.
flows.ends: The game acknowledges the tempered blade loadout, and the clan sees the delivered availability message; the player starts the raid in the game.

flows.goal: Sell an unequipped sword after checking its gold return.
flows.ends: The sword is removed once and the acknowledged gold balance includes its sale value.

flows.goal: Compare this week’s clan rank and power before raid planning.
flows.ends: The player can name the current rank and roster presence, then post a grounded raid plan.

flows.goal: Choose display visibility and quest reminders for this player.
flows.ends: Reopening preferences retains the selected server, display visibility and reminder opt-in.

flows.goal: Understand power, crests and what the companion cannot do.
flows.ends: The player can distinguish power from weekly rank and knows raids start in the game.

flows.goal: Understand the companion and open my linked character.
flows.ends: The player reaches the synced character overview, not an unsupported account-link form.

flows.goal: Check an opted-in quest deadline before it expires.
flows.ends: The notification opens the active arena quest with its current deadline and progress.

surfaces.question: Which quest is ready, and what should I prepare for the next session?

binding.because: Completed quest rewards and the next unfinished quest lead the second screen.

surfaces.question: Which quest can I finish or claim before it expires?

slots.because: The acknowledged quest and inventory destination stay visible after a claim.

surfaces.question: Which gear improves my current loadout?

slots.because: A sale permanently removes the named gear; the gold return must be reviewed before committing.
The game-acknowledged gear swap stays beside the selected loadout.

surfaces.question: Who can fill the next raid slot, and what availability should I post?

binding.because: The healer request needs the current clan roster alongside delivered raid-planning messages.

surfaces.question: Who is ready for the raid, and where do I rank this week?
Which player display, server and quest reminder preferences should persist?

binding.because: Display visibility and quest reminders belong to the same player and fit one preference section.

surfaces.question: How do power and weekly crests work, and where must I start a raid?
What can I manage for my Hollowmere character between game sessions?
How much time remains for my active arena quest, and what progress is still needed?
